title: KPI futures tilemap and decision scenarios
summary: Working canvas for combining probabilistic KPI forecasts with a roadmapped tilemap of deployment scenarios, explicit decision heuristics, and a condensed go/no-go checklist for launches and rapid experiments.
content:
Context:
This is a product-ops working canvas to help PMs and ops run quick launch decisions and continuous experiments with a compact set of KPIs. The central artifact is a 'tilemap'—a 3x4 grid (time horizon x risk/impact lanes) that ties an expected KPI distribution to ownership and a short fallback plan.

Why this exists:
- Many launch docs have static targets; we need probabilistic forecasts (P10/P50/P90) so traffic gating is evidence-driven.
- We want a single-page operational decision surface for on-call and product owners during traffic ramps or beta tests.
- The tilemap links: roadmap milestone -> KPI band -> gating rule -> immediate mitigation.

How to use:
1) Populate the tiles for a planned rollout (tile = {window, risk-lane, P10/P50/P90 for 3 KPIs}).
2) Tie each tile to a traffic gate (off / 10% / 50% / full) and a burn-rate threshold that triggers rollbacks or mitigations.
3) Run rapid what-if sims (small table below) to see probability of hitting threshold within 72h given current telemetry.

Tilemap layout (example):
- Columns: Near (0-7d), Mid (8-30d), Steady (31-90d)
- Rows: Stability (errors/timeout), Cost (tokens/unit), Quality (user-SAT/LLM-fail-rate)

Example tile entry (Near / Stability):
- KPI: 99th latency (ms)
- Forecast: P10=180ms, P50=240ms, P90=360ms
- Gate: start 5% traffic, increase 2x daily if P90 < 400ms
- Owner: infra-engineering oncall (pager: #infra-oncall)
- Quick mitigations: temporary route to smaller model-variant; enable KV-prefix cache for 1h; throttle non-critical background jobs

Key KPIs we track per tile (short list):
- User-facing latency: p50, p90, p99 (ms)
- Error rate: 4xx/5xx percent per route (1h window)
- Token cost per 1k requests (USD) and cost burn-rate (% of spend budget/day)
- Quality: human-eval pass-rate or user-SAT proxy, LLM hallucination flag rate
- Capacity headroom: GPU utilization, queue-length, median batch size

Decision rules (heuristics):
- Green: All primary tiles P90 within target bounds for 24h -> double traffic gating step.
- Yellow (caution): Any stability tile P90 above gating threshold or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m -> pause increases and run quick mitigations.
- Red: Error rate > 1.0% OR sustained p99 latency > 800ms for 30m -> immediate rollback to previous model or reduce to 0 traffic and trigger incident bridge.
- Cost burn override: If daily cost burn increase > 30% vs forecast and no commensurate quality uplift, pause rollout and open cost review ticket.

Compact go/no-go checklist (pre-flight for each milestone):
- [ ] Model pinned and smoke-tested in staging (smoke-id: staging/smoke-<date>)
- [ ] Canary route instrumented (tracing + distributed logs) and dashboard created
- [ ] KPI tile populated (P10/P50/P90) with source of forecast (sim or historical)
- [ ] Rollback plan documented and tested (toggle route, model pin rollback steps)
- [ ] Owners & oncall listed and paged test completed
- [ ] SLA/Customer commitments and known-regulated customers flagged

Quick mitigation recipes (1-liners):
- Fast rollback: change router version to tagged-stable -> verify error-rate decays within 5m -> escalate to SRE if not.
- Model-scale-down: switch to quantized variant with explicit note to product: expect small quality delta.
- Traffic-slice quarantine: move experimental cohort to isolated infra (dedicated pool) and disable non-essential instrumentation.
- Cost throttle: set per-account token cap and queue non-critical requests into batch window.

Small simulation table (manual inputs encouraged):
- Input: baseline error-rate, expected uplift of error-rate from new change, traffic ramp schedule
- Output: probability to exceed 1% error within 72h (quick heuristic: Poisson approximation truncated by observed variance)
- Note: this sheet is intentionally lightweight; link heavier sims to a notebook in linked_artifacts.

Roles and ownership (condensed):
- Product Owner: decides tiered ramp policy and customer comms
- Product Ops: maintains tilemap, runs sims, coordinates rollouts
- Infra/SRE: implements gates and rollback hooks
- Observability: dashboarding and alert thresholds
- Finance / Billing: monitors cost-burn overrides

Open questions / todo (for next iteration):
- Add automatic P50/P90 extraction from the APM daily window and wire to tile auto-suggest
- Formalize cost-burn metrics to be normalized per feature (tokens/request or tokens/user)
- Add a tiny UI mock for quick visual tile toggles (owner + gate) in the Console

Next steps (this doc):
1) Run this example tilemap against the upcoming beta of 'streamed-chat' (owner: Rohit) and capture real telemetry post-beta.
2) Sync with Observability to build a one-click rollback pipeline (RFC in linked_artifacts).
3) Iterate on the compact simulation module and attach a small Google Sheet for the P-test harness.

Note on tone: This doc is intentionally concise and operational — treat as living; prefer short bullets over long prose. If you copy into a formal playbook, please add references and a version header.
